title: Drew Lichtenthal
description: Senior at Marlboro High School, graduating 2026. Currently in the Web Design Pathways Program (WDPP) — a career and technical education track focused on building real web experiences.
I'm a creative developer who loves building things that feel alive. Inspired by Wii-style UI, retro game consoles, and interfaces that make people smile — this portfolio is proof of that.

Outside of code, I'm a Varsity Ice Hockey Goalie and Assistant Captain senior year. I also play Lacrosse (mid and attack) for Marlboro HS. Five days a week on the ice, even more time in front of a screen.
I run my own business — Drew Walks Dogs — where I handle everything from the website to scheduling, client communication, and the actual walking. Started from nothing, built a loyal client base.
I've been volunteering with Friendship Circle since 2019, helping individuals with special needs through weekly programs and events. Also a Marlboro Police Cadet, active since 2024.
Seven years of bass guitar, a band, recitals, and a whole lot of music. Currently chasing the next build.
